full_prompt_en: A square, grainy monochrome photograph presents a young dark-haired man in an extremely close head-and-shoulders portrait, framed by a narrow pale border. His face fills nearly all of the central image, with wavy hair brushing the top edge and a light shirt collar rising at the lower right. He looks directly toward the viewer, though the eye on the image left is partly swallowed by a broad shadow. The other eye remains sharply visible beneath a softly arched brow, its small highlight holding the focus. A strong side light models the forehead, bridge of the nose, cheekbone, and upper lip on the image right. The nose projects into the dark division at the center, and the mouth sits closed with a slight downward tension. A pale fold of shirt curves along the neck and jaw at the lower right, standing out against a dark textured jacket. The background is almost black and gives no identifiable room or landscape; only a muted tonal halo separates some hair from it. Fine photographic grain covers both the skin and dark areas, making the surface feel aged and tactile. The framing is so close that the visible ear approaches the right border and the lower chin nearly touches the bottom. The light falls from the upper image right, leaving the opposite cheek, eye socket, and neck in deep shade while retaining delicate midtones across the lit skin. The overall composition is intimate and severe, using a split of light and darkness, direct gaze, and tight crop to create quiet psychological tension.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形、带颗粒的单色照片呈现一位深发年轻男子的极近头肩肖像，外有一圈窄浅色边框。他的脸几乎填满中央图像，波浪发梢擦过上边缘，浅色衬衫领在右下方升起。他直视观者，不过画面左侧那只眼部分被宽阔阴影吞没。另一只眼在柔弯眉下清晰可见，一点小高光成为焦点。强侧光塑造画面右侧的额头、鼻梁、颧骨和上唇。鼻子伸进中央的暗部交界，嘴闭着，略带向下的紧绷。右下方的浅色衬衫褶边沿脖颈与下颌弯曲，在深色有纹理的外套前突出。背景近乎全黑，没有可辨认的房间或风景；只有轻微明暗光晕把部分头发从背景中分开。细摄影颗粒覆盖皮肤和暗部，使表面显得陈旧而可触。画框如此贴近，以至可见耳朵逼近右边，下巴几乎触及底边。光从画面右上方落下，使另一侧面颊、眼窝和颈部留在深影中，同时受光皮肤仍保留细腻中间调。整体构图亲密而严峻，以明暗对分、直接目光和紧凑裁切形成安静的心理张力。
style_prompt_en: The image has an aged monochrome photographic finish with visible fine grain and a narrow pale boundary around a dense dark field. One side of the focal volume is modeled in soft silvery midtones while the other sinks into substantial black. A small sharp highlight anchors attention amid otherwise gradual transitions. Edges remain crisp in the lit center but weaken into the backdrop around darker outer contours. Close cropping removes spatial context and makes subtle tonal changes and surface texture unusually important. Side lighting reaches raised planes and declines quickly into recesses, giving the image a sculptural but restrained contrast. The overall effect is intimate, austere, and quietly uneasy.
style_prompt_zh: 画面呈现老照片式单色摄影质感，可见细颗粒，密实暗域周围还有一圈窄浅边界。焦点体积的一侧由柔和银灰中间调塑造，另一侧沉入厚重黑色。一点细小锐亮部在其余渐变中锚定注意力。受光中央的边缘保持清楚，外侧较暗轮廓则逐渐融入背景。近距离裁切移除空间语境，使细微明暗变化与表面肌理格外重要。侧光触及凸起平面，又快速衰减入凹处，形成雕塑般却克制的反差。整体效果亲密、简峻且安静地令人不安。
theme_en: A grainy monochrome close portrait of a dark-haired young man with one side of his face in shadow
theme_zh: 一位深发年轻男子半边脸隐入阴影的颗粒黑白近景肖像
name: Roman Polanski
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
